create_BioMRC_dataset: create a BioMRC dataset instance to load biomedical multiple choice reading comprehension data
load_biomrc_dataset: load the biomrc_large_B dataset from Hugging Face using the load_dataset method
generate_k_shot_data: generate k-shot few-shot learning data splits with configurable seed and shot count
map_hf_dataset_to_list: map a Hugging Face dataset split to a list of question context answer tuples
get_train_test_lines: get shuffled train and test line pairs from the BioMRC dataset with 10 percent test sampling
